Chapters 3 to 5

School · Life Writing · Three Stories

You need: the novel, your exercise book, a pen.

01
Step 1 · Before we read · 2 min

New people and words to know

New people

  • Harry: a boy in Conor's class who bullies him
  • Anton and Sully: Harry's followers
  • Lily Andrews: Conor's friend since they were small
  • Miss Kwan: Head of Year
  • Mrs Marl: the English teacher

Words to know

  • cronies: followers who do what someone says
  • Form: form class, where the day starts
  • detention: staying behind as a punishment
  • life writing: writing about your own life
  • vindaloo: a very spicy curry

Step 2 · Read · 6 min

Chapter 3: "School"

Follow in your book while I read

Listen for

  1. Who helps Conor?
  2. What does Conor tell Miss Kwan?

We will stop twice

Stop 1: "I just fell. They were helping me up."
Why does Conor lie?

Stop 2: end of the chapter, "Well done, O'Malley."
How does Harry feel?

03
Step 3 · Read · 7 min

Chapter 4: "Life Writing"

Follow in your book while I read

Listen for

  1. What happy memory does Conor have?
  2. Why is Conor angry with Lily?

We will stop twice

Stop 1: "But he wasn't going to be writing about that either."
Why won't he write about a happy memory?

Stop 2: end of the chapter, "it was just a tree again."
Real or imagined? Thumbs up or down.

07
Step 7 · Questions 5-6: reading between the lines · 7 min · in your book
5

Why does Harry say this to Conor? What does it show about Harry?

"Well done, O'Malley," Harry said.
Harry says this because ... This shows that Harry ...
Who did Conor's lie keep out of trouble? Is Harry being kind, or is he making fun of Conor?
6

What had Mum done, and why?

"When they'd had the 'little talk' the next day, he knew what his mum had done and why she had done it."
Mum gave Conor ... because she knew ...
What did they do the night before? What do you think the "little talk" was about?

Finished? In Chapter 5, Conor stops squirming when the monster talks about "the thing you are most afraid of". Why?

Step 8 · Real or dream? · 6 min · whole class

Vote with your thumbs, then move each clue.

Clues

Ch 1The clock says 12.07 when the monster comes.
Ch 2In the morning, the window has "no damage at all".
Ch 2Yew leaves cover the bedroom floor.
Ch 2Conor says the leaves blew in. "Clearly."
Ch 2Mum: "I could have sworn I heard your voice."
Ch 4The tree makes a face at Conor in daylight. Then "it was just a tree again."
Ch 5Conor wakes up in his own bed with a shout.
Ch 5Berries cover the floor, but the window was "closed and locked".

Real

Dream

09
Step 9 · Before you go · 3 min

Real or dream? Now with two clues.

On Monday you used one clue. Today, use two.

I think the monster is real / a dream / I'm not sure because [clue 1]. Also, [clue 2].

Then: add one new clue to your Theme tracker (Supernatural vs. Reality page). The berries are a good one.

Next lesson: Chapters 6 and 7. Grandma arrives.

10
Check your answers · 4 min · now if there's time, or at the start of Thursday

Click each number. Tick it, or fix it in a different colour.

  1. Miss Kwan Conor tells Miss Kwan that he just fell and the boys were helping him up.
  2. Lily Lily gets into trouble because she pushes Sully into a bush after he insults Conor's mother.
  3. Angry Conor is angry with Lily because her mum found out about his mum's illness, then Lily knew, and then everyone knew.
  4. Deal The monster says it will tell Conor three stories. Then Conor must tell it a fourth, and it must be the truth.
  5. Harry Harry says this because Conor's lie kept Harry out of trouble. It shows that Harry feels in control and enjoys making fun of Conor.
  6. Mum Mum gave Conor one perfect, fun night because she knew the "little talk" would bring bad news, and she wanted him to have a happy memory first.
